name: Circuit Zandvoort
summary: Layout, length, direction and the height profile (already AHN4 lidar) are right. T14 banking matches the lidar. T3 is banked progressively in reality (about 5 deg on the inside, 9-10 deg across the middle, ~20 deg only on the outer 6 m), while the game banks the whole width at 19 deg. Tarzan, Hunserug, Rob Slotemaker and Scheivlak have real 4.5-7 deg cambers the game renders at 1-3 deg. The pit limit was 60 km/h before 2025 (game: 80 for every season). Scenery: a phantom concrete deck floats over the main straight (the OSM outline of the track own deck over a service tunnel).

findings.game: bankOverrides T3 Hugenholtzbocht 19 deg from lap fraction 0.20053 to 0.23226 (854-989 m): planar 19 deg across the whole road (game mean over the corner 17.7 deg).
findings.real: AHN4 lidar cross-sections through T3 (OSM way 1311522216, 480-600 m along the OSM lap): best-fit slope over the central +-3 / +-7 / +-10 m = 8.9-10.4 deg; the profile is concave: ~5 deg on the inside half, 18-23 deg on the outer 6 m (e.g. at OSM s 520: +0.62 m over the inner 7 m, +2.50 m over the next 6 m outward). Published: en.wikipedia "turn 3 has a 19-degree bank"; nl.wikipedia gives T3 18 / T14 19 deg; OSM way 1311522216 description "Helling 32% / 18 graden". The published figure is the steep outer part.
findings.proposedFix: Keep 19 deg as the published peak if the cross-section stays planar (it is what makes the bowl visible), or model the progressive cross-section (inside ~5 deg rising to ~20 deg at the outer edge). Do not lower it to the centre value without a variable cross-section: the user already finds the banking not pronounced.

findings.game: Curvature-derived bank: Tarzanbocht mean 3.3 deg (max 5.1), Hunserug 0.9, Rob Slotemakerbocht 1.5, Scheivlak 2.4, the braking zone before Tarzan 0.4; but 4.4-5 deg in CM.com bocht and the Hans Ernst chicane entry where the road is nearly flat.
findings.real: AHN4 cross slopes (planar, consistent over +-3..+-10 m): Tarzanbocht 6.4-7.4 deg, the approach to Tarzan 5.1-5.4, Hunserug 4.7-5.4, Rob Slotemakerbocht 4.4-4.8 (both directions of the S), Scheivlak 4.1-5.9; CM.com bocht 1.5-1.7, Hans Ernst chicane entry 1.1-1.2. Every one inside-lower.
findings.proposedFix: bankOverrides from the lidar (proposedCorrection.bankOverridesFromLidar: Tarzan 6.5, Hunserug 4.5, Rob Slotemaker 4.5 / 5, Scheivlak 5 deg ...). This also helps the "banking not felt" complaint at Zandvoort.

findings.game: pitLimitKmh absent -> 80 km/h for every season (js/track.js lane at 80). Lane on the right (correct), entry 169 m before the line, exit 164 m after.
findings.real: 60 km/h until 2024, 80 km/h from the 2025 Dutch GP (en.wikipedia "2025 Dutch Grand Prix": "The pit lane speed limit was increased from 60 km/h to 80 km/h", citing Pirelli; speedcafe.com; planetf1.com). Whether all of 2021-2024 ran at 60 was not checked year by year (the 2025 sources call 60 the previous limit). OSM way 38144527 "Pitstraat" (759 m) leaves 173 m before the line (game 169: matches) and rejoins 615 m after it, past Tarzan.
findings.proposedFix: Season-dependent limit: 60 km/h for the 2021-2024 Dutch GP seasons, 80 from 2025 (e.g. pitLimitKmhBySeason {"2021":60,"2022":60,"2023":60,"2024":60}); if only one value is possible keep 80 (2025-2026 and the default season 2026).

findings.game: js/scenery.js builds a floating concrete deck OVER the main straight 160 m before the line (lap s 4101, underside 8.8 m above the road; scenery-data.js "bridge" at 52.387092, 4.539550; screenshot shots/shot-zandvoort-phantom.png). It is a phantom.
findings.real: That item is OSM way 765476850 (man_made=bridge, layer 1, 232 m2) = the track's own deck over the service tunnel OSM way 186321842 (layer -1) under the main straight. OSM has nothing crossing over the lap; only service / foot tunnels pass under it (ways 186321842, 906789803, 906789798). AHN4 shows no dip there.
findings.proposedFix: Drop OSM way 765476850 from the scenery bridges (proposedCorrection.sceneryBridgesToDrop) or skip man_made=bridge outlines that carry the lap.

sceneryBridgesToDrop.rule: a man_made=bridge outline that contains the lap centreline and has a tunnel / layer<0 way crossing the lap inside it, or a bridge=yes raceway inside it, is the lap own deck: do not build it over the road (tools/build-scenery.mjs or js/scenery.js addBridge)

measurements.method: devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/audit.mjs: game = tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (out/game-<id>.json from dump-game.js); OSM = Overpass (cache/overpass/<id>.json), the F1 lap chained from its raceway ways in their oneway direction; DEM sampled every 5 m along the OSM centreline, 25 m median + 5 m Gauss; game heights mapped to the OSM centreline by nearest point and aligned by the mean difference

direction.note: fraction of game samples whose direction agrees with the OSM oneway raceway direction

crossSlope.note: lidar cross slope = atan((h(left) - h(right)) / (2 * halfBase)), negative = left side lower; game bank = samples[i].bank (same sign convention); median of 3 measurements
